label: Tomato___Early_blight
symptoms: Dark concentric spots on older leaves, yellowing, defoliation.
organic_treatment: Neem oil 5ml/L, remove affected leaves, Trichoderma soil application.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at 10-day interval. Follow label safety.
prevention: Crop rotation, drip irrigation, mulching, balanced fertilization.

label: Tomato___Late_blight
symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves and fruits, white mildew under humid conditions.
organic_treatment: Destroy infected plants, copper oxychloride limited dose, garlic extract.
prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation, resistant varieties, forecast-based spraying.

label: Tomato___Leaf_Mold
symptoms: Yellow spots upper leaf, olive-green mold beneath, leaf curl.
organic_treatment: Baking soda spray 5g/L + neem oil, improve ventilation.
prevention: Spacing, staking, drip irrigation, resistant hybrids.

label: Tomato___healthy
prevention: Regular scouting, balanced nutrition, clean seed.

label: Potato___Early_blight
symptoms: Target-board spots on leaves, tuber blemishes.
organic_treatment: Compost tea, neem oil, remove debris.
prevention: Certified seed tubers, rotation with cereals, earthing up.

label: Potato___Late_blight
symptoms: Black lesions, white sporulation, rapid collapse in humid weather.
organic_treatment: Haul out and bury infected haulms, Bordeaux mixture 1%.
prevention: Disease forecasting (e.g. CPRI), resistant cv. Kufri Jyoti.

label: Potato___healthy
prevention: Clean seed, balanced NPK, regular scouting.

label: Maize___Common_rust
symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on leaves, reduced photosynthesis.
organic_treatment: Sulphur dust, resistant hybrids next season.
prevention: Early sowing, weed control, avoid dense planting.

label: Maize___healthy
prevention: Seed treatment with Azospirillum, timely irrigation.

label: Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight
symptoms: Yellowing and drying from leaf tip, wilting in severe cases.
organic_treatment: Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment, drain field briefly.
chemical_treatment: Streptocycline 150ppm + Copper oxychloride. Consult agri officer.
prevention: Resistant varieties (Swarna, IR64), balanced nitrogen, sanitation.

label: Rice___Brown_spot
symptoms: Dark brown oval spots, poor grain filling.
organic_treatment: Silicon-rich manure, neem seed kernel extract.
prevention: Potassium nutrition, water management, clean seed.

label: Cotton___Bacterial_blight
symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots, boll rot in late stage.
organic_treatment: Acid delinting of seed, Trichoderma seed treatment.
prevention: Resistant Bt hybrids, field sanitation, rotation.

label: Cotton___healthy
prevention: Pheromone traps for bollworm, regular scouting.

label: Wheat___Yellow_rust
symptoms: Yellow stripe pustules on leaves, shrivelled grains.
organic_treatment: Early sowing of resistant varieties (HD-2967), remove volunteer wheat.
prevention: Resistant varieties, surveillance in Feb-Mar, balanced fertilizer.
village_advice: Yellow lines on wheat leaf means rust. Spray in evening, do not spray before rain.

label: Cotton___Bollworm
symptoms: Holes in bolls, chewed leaves, caterpillar visible, droppings.
organic_treatment: Pheromone traps 8/acre, neem seed kernel 5%, release Trichogramma.
chemical_treatment: Emamectin benzoate 5SG @ 0.5g/L only if >10% damage. Evening spray.
prevention: Deep ploughing, trap crops, timely sowing.
village_advice: Green worm in cotton ball is bollworm. Put trap, pick worms by hand first.

label: Rice___Stem_borer
symptoms: Dead heart in young plants, white earheads, holes in stem.
organic_treatment: Pheromone traps, neem oil, release dragonflies habitat.
chemical_treatment: Cartap hydrochloride if ETL crossed. Ask agri officer.
prevention: Stubble removal, balanced nitrogen, early planting.
village_advice: Rice stem hollow and white grain means stem borer. Remove stubble after harvest.

label: Maize___Fall_armyworm
symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, sawdust-like waste in leaf funnel, green-brown worm.
organic_treatment: Sand + ash in leaf funnel, neem oil, hand-pick worms morning.
chemical_treatment: Spinetoram or Emamectin in funnel if severe. Evening only.
prevention: Early sowing, intercrop with legumes, scout twice weekly.
village_advice: Big holes in maize heart leaf with worm dirt means armyworm. Put ash-sand mix in funnel.

label: Tomato___Aphids
symptoms: Small black/green insects under leaf, sticky leaf, curled growth.
organic_treatment: Soap water spray, neem oil, yellow sticky traps.
chemical_treatment: Imidacloprid only if heavy. Avoid during flowering.
village_advice: Tiny sticky insects under leaf are aphids. Spray soap-neem water first.
